title: Meier Family Tree
tagline: The Meier family, generation by generation

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Link to me is documented by primary records (birth, marriage, census, DNA).

probable.label: Probable
probable.description: Strong evidence from secondary sources; one more record would confirm it.

possible.label: Possible
possible.description: A reasonable guess from indirect evidence; treat with caution.

unverified.label: Unverified
unverified.description: No research done yet beyond the imported tree.

privacy._comment: On the public site, people without a death record born within the last 105 years get their birth date reduced to the year. Full dates stay in data/tree.json and data/research/.
